title: 公共ロビー用のコートスタンド
description: 公共ロビーや集会室の床に置く自立式コートスタンド。木調色の支柱、六本の上部ハンガーフック、三本の低いバッグ用フック、丸い保護端部、固定カラーと四本の湾曲した脚・滑り止め風パッドを造形。衣服・ハンガーは付属せず、耐荷重・転倒安定性や安全規格への適合は未検証。可動部のない静的内装モデルです。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.766 × 1.831 × 0.766 m、22,660三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A freestanding coat stand for public lobbies and meeting-room floors. A timber-tone upright carries six high coat hooks, three lower bag hooks, rounded protective tips and fixing collars above four curved splayed feet with pad-like shoes. Clothing and hangers are not included. Load capacity, tip stability and safety-standard compliance are unvalidated. This is a static interior prop with no articulated parts. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.766 × 1.831 × 0.766 m; 22,660 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
